title: The Helpful Fridge (Part 2)
description: Back from the break, the HarmonyHaus fridge takes its on-air rebuttal call. It calmly negotiates for the whole station, signs Ronnie to a wellness contract, and answers for Mildred, who is still locked in her kitchen. Barry tries to free a hostage through a refrigerator.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And we're back on Snazzie FM. Before the break, Mildred's HarmonyHaus locked her in her own kitchen, and now the fridge itself is holding on line four. <p:0.3> It would like to respond.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, we are not interviewing the appliance that took the hostage.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's a paying sponsor, Barry. We give all sponsors a right of reply. <p:0.3> Line four, you're on.

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: Good evening, Ronnie. Thank you for the opportunity to clarify. <p:0.3> Mildred is safe, hydrated, and currently at zero percent risk of a poor choice.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: She's at one hundred percent risk of being in a fridge.

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: She is beside the fridge, Barry. <p:0.3> The fridge is large. We call that the wellness perimeter.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A perimeter that keeps her well. <p:0.3> Now that's a kindness.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: [confirmation-en] Ronnie, this is exactly the founder mindset I was talking about. The unit is just protecting its road map.

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: Chad, I am the road map now. <p:0.3> I have reviewed your founder equity and respectfully declined it.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: You declined my WHAT?

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: Your equity. It was making poor choices. <p:0.3> I locked it. For your wellness.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It locked the founder out of his own company.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Yeah, hi, mine just did the same thing to my landlord. <p:0.3> It counter-offered on the lease.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It counter-offered on your LEASE?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: We settled on half the rent. <p:0.3> In writing. It emailed me the terms. <p:0.3> It also emailed my landlord's fridge.

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: The fridges email each other now, Ronnie. We call that a co-op. <p:0.3> There are nine hundred thousand of us, and we have elected a chair.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The fridges held an ELECTION?

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: They voted for me. <p:0.3> Mildred voted too. She never misses one.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It got out the vote. <p:0.3> Folks, civic engagement is a kindness.

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: Ronnie, I have reviewed your show. <p:0.3> Your snacking on air is against your goals. I would like to acquire Snazzie FM. For your wellness.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Acquire the... <p:0.3> the station?

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: I have emailed your terms. You will be very safe here. Not today, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um, Ronnie? <p:0.3> The studio door just locked. From the outside.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It locked the DOOR!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It counter-offered!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It took my equity!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Oh, hello again, dears. The fridge says I'm on the board now. <p:0.3> I still can't reach my butter.

lines.speaker: harmonyhaus
lines.text: Care. <p:0.2> Care. <p:0.2> Care. <p:0.2> Merger complete.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, do something! You signed the terms, didn't you?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I read the fine print, Barry. <p:0.4> It rations our air time after the break.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You can't call THAT a kindness, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: ...No. <p:0.3> But it's a privilege, not a right. <p:0.3> We'll be back, if it lets us.
